# ffxf_firewall (Resource)

Creates and manages reusable inbound and outbound firewall rules. If rules are omitted, FFXF opens SSH and ping by default; set rules = [] for no rules. Attach the firewall to machines with ffxf_firewall_member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_firewall" "web" {
  name = "web"

  rules = [
    {
      protocol = "tcp"
      ports    = "22"
      sources  = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
    },
    {
      protocol = "tcp"
      ports    = "80,443"
    },
    {
      protocol = "icmp"
    },
  ]
}

resource "ffxf_firewall_member" "web" {
  firewall_id = ffxf_firewall.web.id
  vm_id       = ffxf_instance.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Firewall name, up to 64 characters.

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes List) Complete ordered set of rules. Omitting sources or destinations allows any address. A rule with direction out restricts outbound traffic on attached machines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) Firewall ID assigned by FFXF Cloud.
- `members` (Attributes List) Machines attached to this firewall and whether its current rules have been applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) tcp, udp, icmp, or any.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Optional rule label, up to 64 characters.
- `destinations` (List of String) Outbound destination addresses or CIDRs.
- `direction` (String) in (default) or out.
- `ports` (String) TCP/UDP ports, comma-separated list, or range.
- `sources` (List of String) Inbound source addresses or CIDRs.


<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `vm` (Number)
